title: Canonical stalk comparison under a subopen restriction
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $P,Q$ arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix $y\in V\subseteq U\subseteq Y$, an integer $n$, and a map $f:R_U(P^n)\to R_U(Q^n)$. Write $j:V\to U$, $C:R_V\cong R_U R_j$ for the canonical restriction-composition isomorphism, $S_U,S_V$ for module pullback from $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ [def-pc-module-pullback], and $E_U,E_V$ for stalkRestrictionComplexIso [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]. Then $S_V(C(P).\mathrm{hom}_n;R_j(f);C(Q).\mathrm{inv}_n)=E_V(P).\mathrm{hom}_n;E_U(P).\mathrm{inv}_n;S_U(f);E_U(Q).\mathrm{hom}_n;E_V(Q).\mathrm{inv}_n$. No chain equations on $f$, boundedness, or finite freeness are assumed.

source.place: lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-degreewise-shrink, step 3: transitivity and associativity of stalk pullback comparisons

proof.text: Define C by restrictFunctorCongr(homOfLE_ι) inverse followed by restrictFunctorComp, then apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex. Let j:V->U. Cancel U.ι in the equality of the two morphisms from Spec O_(Y,y) into U and use fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι to obtain V.fromSpecStalkOfMem ; j = U.fromSpecStalkOfMem. Replace restriction along j by pullback, then use pullbackComp and pullbackCongr to obtain D:R_j ; S_V ~= S_U.

Replace all restriction functors by pullbacks through restrictFunctorIsoPullback. Its compatibility with restriction composition follows by comparing the units of the restriction and pullback adjunctions; these maps are the uniqueness-of-left-adjoint isomorphisms of the common pushforward. Apply Scheme.Modules.pseudofunctor_associativity to the three maps from the stalk scheme through V and U to Y. This identifies S_V(C(M)) ; D(R_U M) with E_V(M) ; E_U(M) inverse. Use naturality of D on f, substitute this identification on P and Q, cancel inverse/hom pairs, and take the n-th component. The argument applies to U=V and zero objects without changes.

theorem stalkRestrictionComplexIso_map_subopen
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (y : Y) (U V : Y.Opens) (hyU : y ∈ U) (hyV : y ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (n : ℤ)
    (f : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (P.X n) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (Q.X n)) :
    let C := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
      ((restrictFunctorCongr (Y.homOfLE_ι hVU)).symm ≪≫
        restrictFunctorComp (Y.homOfLE hVU) U.ι) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).map
      (((C.app P).hom.f n) ≫ (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hVU)).map f ≫
        ((C.app Q).inv.f n)) =
      ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso V y hyV).app P).hom.f n ≫
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app P).inv.f n ≫
        (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map f ≫
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app Q).hom.f n ≫
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso V y hyV).app Q).inv.f n
